title: Security headers
intro: Sent with every answer of the site, error pages included. A header switched on here replaces the same header from the application. Switched off, the application's own header passes through unchanged.

sniff.label: MIME type sniffing
sniff.hint: Browsers trust the declared type of every file.

referrer.label: Referrer
referrer.hint: What other sites learn about the page a visitor came from.

permissions.label: Browser features
permissions.hint: Which features the site and embedded frames may use.
permissions.strict: Strict: camera, microphone, location, payment and USB off
permissions.ownHint: Comma-separated, for example camera=(), geolocation=(self "https://maps.example.com"). At most {{max}} bytes.

csp.modeHint: Report only shows violations in the browser console without blocking anything.
csp.policyHint: Directives separated by ";", for example default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:. At most {{max}} bytes.
csp.enforceWarning: A policy that is too strict breaks the site at once: blocked scripts, styles or fonts. Test it with report only first.

saved: Saved. nginx sends the new headers now.

search.title: Search engines
search.label: Ask search engines not to index the site
search.hint: Every answer gets <mono>X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow</mono>, so well-behaved crawlers keep the site out of their results. On for staging copies. It does not hide the site: use a password under Security, Access for that.
search.doneOn: Search engines are asked not to index the site.
search.doneOff: Search engines may index the site.

problems.permissions: Enter a Permissions-Policy or switch it off.
problems.csp: Enter a Content-Security-Policy or switch it off.

errors.conflict: {{reason}}. Remove it from the snippet first.
errors.siteGone: The site does not exist anymore.
errors.generic: The security headers could not be loaded or saved. Try again.
